question: What is the Incident Response Policy?
short_answer: Security incidents are classified as Sev-1 (critical), Sev-2 (major), or Sev-3 (minor) on detection.
detailed_answer: Security incidents are classified as Sev-1 (critical), Sev-2 (major), or Sev-3 (minor) on detection. Sev-1 incidents require containment action within 1 hour of confirmation. All confirmed incidents involving customer data are reported to Legal within 4 hours. A post-incident review is completed within 5 business days of resolution.
escalation_path: Security Analyst -> Incident Response Lead -> Security Manager -> CISO

short_answer: All employees complete mandatory phishing awareness training annually.

escalation_path: Security Analyst -> Incident Response Lead -> Security Manager -> CISO

question: What is the Data Protection Policy?
